PROP-57888860-inv-012.text: Inverse FFT must apply normalization factor 1/N and reverse roots order (except first element).
PROP-57888860-inv-012.assertion: forall fft_field(vals, roots, inv=True): result == [x * (1/len(vals)) for x in _fft_field(vals, reverse(roots[1:]))]

locations.note: Inverse FFT with normalization. Uses reversed roots and normalizes output.
